title: 6-Month NDA Course – Pune 18–65, 23–30 Oct
primaryText:
For students in 12th or 12th passed who are aiming for NDA. The April 2027 exam is about 6 months away. That's enough time, if preparation starts now and follows a plan.

✅ 6-month structured plan: the full NDA Maths + GAT syllabus
✅ Regular full-length mock tests with detailed analysis
✅ Chapter-wise notes, PYQs and practice, in small batches with doubt support

📍 Offline classes: LWS Pune Defence Academy, Sagar Arcade, FC Road, Pune

Tap "Send message" to get batch timings and fees on WhatsApp.
